_meta.purpose: Full-depth per-workflow enrichment for the SO Trainer engine: POINTER (system-touch order), workflow guidance, special note constructs, and field-source notes. Grounded in DATA_REVIEW_FINDINGS.md + knowledge_base_v4.json. Note templates themselves stay in the KB.
_meta.facs_note: facs_default is a starting suggestion only — the binary toggle is always user-driven. UNCHANGED when facilities are held/untouched; CHANGED when ports/pairs move, add, or release.
_meta.provenance: PTCGIS_ServiceOrders.docx (Rosetta), Quintrex legacy doc, Troy Feldner .msg emails, RCF PDFs. Derived (template-only) specs are marked derived:true.

DISCONNECT_ONLY.branch: Plain disconnect of a service (TEL or DSL).
DISCONNECT_ONLY.guidance: Remove the line; facilities normally stay assigned unless explicitly released. If internet is disconnecting, include the card/port so NetOps can de-provision.
pointer: LinePacks: CO Disconnect the line; clear the agreement; Status += CODISC + date.
Cable Book: line through the 4-digit number; write CODISC + date.
iVUE: Service Points tab -> Disconnect Service Point (Activity = Disconnect).

field_notes.port1: Primary port being disconnected (LinePacks CSX + Cable Book).
field_notes.port2: Second pair if bonded; omit if single.

VACA_DISCONNECT.branch: Vacation disconnect — facilities HELD for the customer's return.
VACA_DISCONNECT.guidance: Do NOT release the port/pair. iVUE Class Of Serv = VACATION. The facility is reserved so the VACA RECON can reuse it.
pointer: LinePacks: mark vacation; KEEP the port assigned (do not clear facs).
iVUE: Disconnect Service Point, Class Of Serv = VACATION.

NPD.branch: Non-Pay Disconnect — phone removed, QDS (restricted dial tone) stays.
NPD.guidance: Suspend for non-payment; the QDS line remains so the customer keeps restricted service. Facilities held.
pointer: iVUE: Class Of Serv = ARREARS BILLING.

BILLING_ONLY.branch: DISC TEL (CBOL) & Billing Correction — phone off, internet stays.
BILLING_ONLY.guidance: Remove the phone line via CBOL; the internet service stays up on its pair. Mostly a billing correction with a facility note.
pointer: LinePacks: disconnect the TEL line only; leave the DSL/internet pair.
iVUE: billing correction; confirm the internet SP remains connected.

EDGE_DISCONNECT.guidance: EDGE = fiber product. Disconnect the service; note carries the action only (no copper port line).
pointer: iVUE: Disconnect the EDGE Service Point.
LinePacks: clear ONT/GPON assignment if releasing.

NPD_DISCONNECT.branch: Non Paid Suspend on a bonded service (*TEL / *DSL).
NPD_DISCONNECT.guidance: Suspend a bonded customer for non-payment; both legs noted. Facilities held.
pointer: LinePacks: suspend; keep BND TEL/DSL ports (n,n) assigned.
iVUE: Class Of Serv = ARREARS BILLING.

GEN_DISCONNECT_QDS_BILLING.branch: DISC TEL (CBOL), QDS CONN, & Billing Correction.
GEN_DISCONNECT_QDS_BILLING.guidance: Remove the phone (internet stays via CBOL), connect the QDS line, fix billing. The most common CONNECT/RECONNECT pattern.
pointer: LinePacks: DISC TEL (CBOL); CONN the QDS line.
iVUE: connect QDS Service Point; billing correction.

DISC_QDS_RECON.branch: DISC & QDS CONN — disconnect phone, connect QDS.
DISC_QDS_RECON.guidance: Swap the working number off and bring the QDS line on, same facility.

VACA_RECONNECT.branch: Vacation reconnect — customer back; reuse the held facility.
VACA_RECONNECT.guidance: The VACA DISC held the port — reconnect on the same facility. No new assignment needed.
pointer: iVUE: Reconnect Service Point (Activity = Connect) on the held facility.
LinePacks: re-enable; confirm the held port.

field_notes.port: The previously held port, now reconnected.

RECONNECT_ONLY.guidance: Connect the QDS line on an available/held port.
pointer: iVUE: connect the QDS Service Point.

SERVICE_POINT_CORRECTION.branch: Correcting Service Points — record cleanup, usually no facility change.
SERVICE_POINT_CORRECTION.guidance: Fix mismatched SP records so iVUE matches the switch. Often header-only (no port lines).
pointer: iVUE: correct the Service Point association.
LinePacks: verify against the switch (the north-star: records must match what's in the switch).

DISC_QDS_CONN.branch: Disconnect + QDS connect (header desc carried by FACS state).
DISC_QDS_CONN.guidance: Disconnect the old number, connect QDS on the same serving port.

CONNECT_ONLY.guidance: Fresh install — assign facilities and connect. Facilities change (new assignment).
pointer: Cable Book: find an available pair to the drop ped.

UPGRADE_BONDED.branch: Internet upgrade to a bonded tier (e.g. 100/20 BND) — *TEL / *DSL.
UPGRADE_BONDED.guidance: Bonded = two pairs: *TEL leg + *DSL leg, each a port line + location. If ports must move for the bond, set FACS CHANGED and consider a splice.
pointer: LinePacks: confirm/assign BND TEL (n,n) + BND DSL (n,n) ports.
Cable Book: verify the DSL pair to the drop ped (and PIC).
iVUE: update facilities for the bonded agreement.
If a new DSL pair needs splicing -> enable the splice option (email Dispatch).

UPGRADE_ADSL.branch: Upgrade to an ADSL-bonded tier (e.g. 25/3 ADSL BND).
UPGRADE_ADSL.guidance: ADSL bonded upgrade across *TEL / *DSL legs. ADTRAN cards: shorter/faster, good odd/odd & even/even.
pointer: LinePacks: confirm bonded ports for the ADSL tier.

UPGRADE_GENERIC.guidance: Single pair upgrade — one port line. No bonding.
pointer: LinePacks: confirm the single port for the new tier.

GENERAL.branch: Bulk port update (e.g. 'need DSL only BND ports, POTS stays') — up to 16 port lines.
GENERAL.guidance: Per-HAN bulk facility change across many ports. Fill only the ports involved; the rest omit (N/A rule).
pointer: LinePacks: per HAN, assign/move the DSL bond ports; POTS unchanged.

field_notes.port1: First port; add as many as the order needs (others omit).

UPGRADE_VDSL.guidance: VDSL single pair. One port line.

BAD_PORT_UPDATE.branch: Per-Han new ports — moving off bad ports to new *TEL / *DSL ports.
BAD_PORT_UPDATE.guidance: Replace failing ports with new ones; both legs get new port + location. Facilities change.
pointer: LinePacks: GET old ports; PUT the new *TEL/*DSL ports.
iVUE: update facilities to the new ports.

DOWNGRADE.guidance: Step the tier down; usually the same facilities. (Q15 downgrade specifics still settling.)
pointer: LinePacks: adjust the tier on the existing ports.

MOVE.branch: Move service — NEW ADDRESS block + OLD ADDRESS block. Both addresses fully written.
MOVE.guidance: Write up BOTH ends: new address (connect side) and old address (disconnect side). Same or cross exchange. Facilities change.
pointer: Cable Book: find facilities at the NEW address.
LinePacks: assign new port; disconnect old port.
iVUE: Move the agreement; connect new SP, disconnect old SP.

MOVE_QDS.branch: Move DSL between numbers with QDS — *TEL / *DSL at the destination.
MOVE_QDS.guidance: Move the DSL from one number to another, QDS in. Bonded legs at the destination.
pointer: LinePacks: move the DSL ports; QDS in.

FTTH_OTHER.guidance: GPON/ONT path. CBOL = no CRV needed. The Node is the parent GPON (e.g. SVLK_GPON), NOT the splitter — write the GPON so NetOps finds it in Calix.
pointer: LinePacks: assign the GPON/splitter port; Node = parent GPON.
iVUE: connect the fiber Service Point; set the ONT port.

field_notes.port: GPON/ONT serving port (parent GPON as Node).

UPGRADE_FTTH.branch: Fiber upgrade (e.g. INT Upgrade to 100/100 FTTH).
UPGRADE_FTTH.guidance: Step the fiber tier up on the existing ONT path.
pointer: LinePacks: confirm the GPON/ONT port for the new tier.

field_notes.port2: Second service on ONT (PRT-2) if any.

EDGE_UPGRADE.guidance: EDGE product tier change. Action-only note.
pointer: iVUE: update the EDGE agreement tier.

EDGE_OTHER.guidance: EDGE service action. Action-only note (no copper port line).
pointer: iVUE: connect/adjust the EDGE Service Point.

FTTH_CONNECT.guidance: Fiber connect; number in. Derived from a small sample.

EDGE_CONNECT.guidance: Connect an EDGE service; carries the EDGE id + ONT FSAN. Derived from a small sample.
pointer: iVUE: connect the EDGE Service Point; record FSAN.

PATH_TRACE_UPDATE.guidance: Rare path-trace update tied to a fiber connect. Derived from one sample — confirm specifics.
pointer: LinePacks: update the path-trace; QDS in; connect FTTH.

CROSS_CONNECT.branch: Cross-connect — bonded upgrade needing a jumper move at the SAI/X-Connect.
CROSS_CONNECT.guidance: The DSL pair line carries XCONN,n + PIC,n, and a jumper-move instruction tells the splicer which jumper to remove and where to re-jump. Enable the XCONN option to add that instruction line.
pointer: X-Connect report + Cable Book: identify the SAI cross-connect pair (XCONN,n).
Write the jumper-move instruction (remove old jumper, re-jump to new pair).
Email Dispatch / splicer as needed; Route along.

UPGRADE_XCONN.branch: Upgrade with a cross-connect (moved + added pair, XCONN).
UPGRADE_XCONN.guidance: Internet upgrade that also moves/adds a pair via cross-connect. DSL line carries XCONN,n; add the jumper-move instruction.
pointer: X-Connect report + Cable Book: find the XCONN pair.
